long_biography.plain_text:
Butler grew up in Leechburg, Pennsylvania, after his mother died and his steelworker father raised four children. Following Army service, he joined Calgon as a sales correspondent and rose through its chemical-specialties operation. The progression gave him the product and customer knowledge to pursue ownership without a family-business platform.

When Calgon's parent divested the operation in 1991, Butler bought its HVACR wholesaling business and formed Nu-Calgon. He narrowed its focus, centralised distribution and built a specialist sales force serving heating, refrigeration and air-conditioning wholesalers. Under his ownership, new products drove most of the company's growth, while the business developed a reputation for customer training, reliable fulfilment and long employee tenure.
